calls.thesis: Rebound play: Expedia is partnering with Muse, which could redirect bookings through Expedia at Booking's expense. Trading 16x P/E vs 25x avg (~36% discount) — but still cautious on the whole travel-middleman group.
calls.base_case: Muse partnership redirects bookings via Expedia.
calls.bear_case: AI agents + weak consumer both hit travel middlemen; cheapness isn't safety.
